question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Recover
solution:
The correct answer is "Regain"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word given here is "Recover" which means to attain fitness again after being ill for some time.

 
 
• *Example: He has** recovered** from his operation.*
 
 
 
• The marked word here is "Regain" which means to attain something back again.
 
 
• *Example: She **regained **consciousness.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, we can clearly see that both words are exactly similar in meaning. So, these are synonyms.
 
• Therefore,** "regain"** is the answer.

**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us see what is the meaning of the other options:

 
• "Remain" means to be in the same place. 

 
 
• *Example: She **remained** to live in the USA after the war. *
 
 
 
• "Refrain" means **to stop yourself from doing some particular task.
 
 
• *Example: Please **refrain** from listening to music in the office.*
 
 
 
• "Retain" means to continue to have something.
 
 
• *Example: Rubber can **retain** its original shape up to a certain amount of stretching.*
